decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's fluid-handling and machine-tool offer, the minimum quantity lubrication system fits existing engineering and service capabilities, so the firm is likely to learn and improve it rather than withdraw it quickly.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's core filtration knowledge, modular platforms and in-house R&D, which under an absorptive-capacity view makes retention and refinement more likely than exit.

The gravity band coolant filter is closely related to the established coolant filtration business and can be supported through the same production, spare-parts and customer-service base, so it is likely to remain in the range.
